summary: tirith MCP registration switched from http url to the stdio shim (command: tirith, args: [stdio]); installed binary must be 0.1.3+ for the stdio subcommand

new CLI subcommand: tirith update [--version X] [--check] replaces the running binary by re-running the release installer via curl/PowerShell into the binary's own directory; installation and release docs should mention it (docs are claimed by claude-docs-audit and claude-docs-landing, so I did not edit them)
